description: Example Select demo — golden fixtures for deterministic steps; LLM steps use null placeholders.

Normalize Case.description: Water leaked from the upstairs bathroom. The kitchen ceiling below collapsed and the timber floor is cupping.

Parse Examples.title: Upstairs bathroom leak — ceiling collapse below
Parse Examples.scope_text:
1. Isolate water supply to upstairs bathroom.
2. Remove collapsed plasterboard ceiling in kitchen (approx. 4m²).
3. Dry structural timber with dehumidifiers for 5–7 days; monitor moisture readings.
4. Replace damaged ceiling joists where deflection exceeds 5mm.
5. Re-sheet ceiling, stop, and paint to match adjacent areas.

Parse Examples.title: Roof storm damage — tile replacement
Parse Examples.scope_text:
1. Erect edge protection to roof perimeter.
2. Replace broken roof tiles (approx. 12 nr).
3. Reseal ridge capping and valley flashings.
4. Internal: patch ceiling stains only where roof leak was active.

Parse Examples.title: Kitchen renovation — cabinetry only
Parse Examples.scope_text:
1. Remove existing kitchen cabinetry and benchtops.
2. Supply and install new flat-pack cabinetry per plan.
3. Connect plumbing and electrical by licensed trades.
4. No structural or ceiling works included.

Parse Examples.title: Timber floor cupping after slow leak
Parse Examples.scope_text:
1. Confirm subfloor moisture below 12% before floor works.
2. Sand and recoat cupped timber boards in affected zone (approx. 12m²).
3. Replace boards that remain crowned after drying period.
4. Coordinate with ceiling repairs above if leak source not yet rectified.
